premises: Chemical short-range order (SRO) exists in HfNbTaTiZr and can be characterized atom-by-atom.
SRO induces local lattice distortions that modify phonon scattering rates.
Incorporating SRO and local distortions into a model can decouple lattice and electronic heat transport.
The proposed model will improve lattice thermal conductivity prediction accuracy by at least 20% over Debye-based methods.
The model's applicability is supported by prior experimental data on HfNbTaTiZr from 300–1200 K and below 200 K.
